shorts.title: A toxic gas is being made in your bathroom. No. Not that one. ☠️ #Shorts
shorts.description:
Never mix bleach with any other cleaner: not toilet bowl cleaner, not vinegar, not glass cleaner.
Agent Peek reports why, and what to do if it happens: get to fresh air fast, and if you have trouble breathing, call 911 and tell them what you mixed.

How many cleaners are in your bathroom right now? Drop the number 👇

Sources:
Washington State Department of Health: https://doh.wa.gov/community-and-environment/contaminants/bleach-mixing-dangers
National Capital Poison Center: https://www.poison.org/articles/chlorine-gas
London Fire Brigade: https://www.london-fire.gov.uk/safety/the-home/dangerous-chemicals/cleaning-products/
